review.rationale: The Decision strictly bounds the correction to a single-line rename of the numeric duplicate key `supplemental_findings` to `supplemental_finding_count` at `/source_review_contract`, preserving the array, all 17 finding IDs, verdict, authorizations, effects, and original commit/hash provenance.
